scientific_integrity: Gaussian asymptotics are proved; finite checks are diagnostics and not infinite proofs; standard order-statistic estimates are background, not original claims.
scientific_limitations: Regular Euclidean simplices and motion-invariant affine hyperplanes only; logarithmic weak limit without convergence rate. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Gaussian-spacing law and a random exponent for affine sections of regular simplices
